none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: strongly_convex
problem_class.details: Only the lower-level function g(x,·) is required to be μ-strongly convex for every x.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The unconstrained hyper-objective Φ(x)=f(x,argmin_y g(x,y)) may be nonconvex.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query (x,y) returns the exact full derivatives of both f and g; replies have no noise or history dependence. Higher derivatives are not supplied.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same query also returns both exact function values f(x,y) and g(x,y).

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: X and Y are finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Globally, f is C² with bounded derivative ‖Df‖≤L and L-Lipschitz first and second derivatives; g is C³ with L-Lipschitz first, second, and third derivatives. Public parameters satisfy 0<μ≤L, Δ>0, G≥0, ε>0. Initialization satisfies Φ(x0)−inf Φ≤Δ and ‖∇_y g(x0,y0)‖≤G. All Params are public; f and g are hidden instance functions.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HigherSmoothBilevel.lean: Params; Instance; spec.Public; spec.publicInput; spec.valid; spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Output x∈X must be a differentiability point of Φ and satisfy ‖∇Φ(x)‖≤ε, without squaring the norm.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The output criterion holds almost surely over the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within the supplied fixed oracle budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: An established unconstrained nonconvex–strongly-convex bilevel formulation with exact first-order access and higher-order smoothness assumptions for accelerated stationarity guarantees.
